reason: A better fivecontext OOF than an old onecontext OOF is not evidence that shared70kpriors improve the already-fivecontext B submission. H010 still supplies a cleaner ensemble validation study. To justify the last public slot, require a distinct supported model improvement inside that matchedensemble.
upload_rule: H010 must select direct_KS under its frozen localpromotion rule. Additionally, directKS fivebag must beat ordinary fivebag with a positive five-contrast-adjusted conditional95percent bootstrap lowerbound (tails .005/.995). Ordinary selection alone does not admit another upload. Full-data refit/audit and officialquota check stillrequired.
comparison_source: Same H010 paired resamples; subtract direct_KS__matched_onebag minus ordinary__matched_onebag bootstrap differences. No new resampling or threshold/weight tuning.
caveat: Still reused development evidence; no guarantee of public or private improvement.
research_full_refit: A nativeH010 selected recipe may be refitted for retained research delivery even if upload is not admitted. Held predictions do not count as a submission. This does not relax the upload rule.
multiplicity_clarification: For upload, compute .005/.995 intervals for all4original contrasts plus direct-versus-ordinary from the same resamples. Require positive lowerbounds for direct-versus-onebag, direct-versus-B and direct-versus-ordinary. Native researchpromotion remains the originallyfrozen fourcontrast rule.
